name: Navs Site

sources.title: Navs Site homepage - curated AI tools directory
Submit a tool - 7-step editorial submission wizard
Pricing - Free plan $0 with automatic publication, no dofollow links; paid Standard/Pro plans

requirements: AI tools directory — a 'Non-AI Tools' category exists but the catalog is AI-focused
Free plan ($0): 'Automatic publication without review', website submissions only, no API access, no featured placement, and NO dofollow links
The submission is a 7-step wizard: Basics, Media, Features & FAQs, Pricing, Details, Alternatives, Review

Required fields include website URL, tool name, one-line description, AI type, platforms, 1-3 product screenshots, ≥1 key feature, pricing model, primary keyword (≤25 chars), tagline, markdown detailed description, tags, and at least one similar published tool as 'alternatives'
preparation: Official website URL, tool name (≤160 chars), one-line description (≤160), tagline (≤250)
Detailed description up to 2500 chars (Markdown supported)
1-3 real product screenshots with concise titles for image SEO; square logo PNG/JPG/WebP up to 1MB (recommended)
Up to 5 categories, AI type, platforms (Web preselected), up to 20 interface languages
Key features (1-10; 3-5 ideal) with names ≤120 chars and descriptions ≤500
Pricing model, pricing details, pricing page URL, free-trial flag
Primary keyword (≤25 chars), up to 10 tags, up to 8 FAQs
At least one already-published similar tool to select as an alternative
Optional: public support email, FAQ/help center URLs, YouTube demo link, private note to reviewer, 'who is it for' audiences
workflow: Open https://navs.site/submit ('Submit a tool' in nav)
Complete the 7 steps: 01 Basics → 02 Media → 03 Features & FAQs → 04 Pricing → 05 Details → 06 Alternatives → 07 Review
Tick the confirmation checkbox ('information is accurate and I have permission to share the images')
Send the listing for review — on the Free plan the listing auto-publishes without review
For API/bulk submissions or editorial services see /docs/api and /pricing paid plans
watchFor: Free-plan listings get NO dofollow link — do not count this submission for dofollow-link goals despite the catalog 'link=follow' note
'Automatic publication without review' on the free tier means whatever you submit goes live as-is — errors publish publicly
Character limits are enforced inline (name 160, one-liner 160, keyword 25, description 2500, tags 10 max)
Alternatives step is required — you must select at least one competing published tool
Launch pricing banner means paid tiers (Standard/Pro) may change; FAQ accordions did not render their answers in static HTML
countsAsLive: The tool page exists at navs.site/website/<slug> (search preview shows 'navs.site › website › your-tool') and appears under Latest additions / category pages
unknowns: Standard and Pro plan prices and their dofollow/featured benefits (FAQ answers not rendered)
Whether free auto-publication is permanent or 'may not always be available' per the FAQ title
Whether login is required to complete the wizard
